title: Pearl Earring
description: Pearl earring, the pearl earring look, is a Dutch interior as grade: one north window, dark earth ground, skin like painted light, a small specular on a jewel. One window, one jewel, one look, and it is not a replica of a copyrighted painting.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Portraits, hush, a character who should feel studied. The head turns.
Eyes go to camera or just off. The wrap is cloth, not a costume joke.

A second practical competing with the window ruins it. It is the wrong tool in a night club, a chase, or a beauty-dish studio.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Pearl Earring in film?
A portrait recipe from Dutch interior grammar: one window, dark ground, painted skin, a jewel as a small specular. It is lighting and color, not a copy of a painting.
Pearl Earring vs Rembrandt Lighting
Rembrandt is a sculpted key that leaves a triangle on the shadow cheek. Pearl earring is cooler north-window light, quieter pigment, jewel as a point. Related lamps, different rooms.
When should I use Pearl Earring?
Hush portraits and studied faces. Skip action, clubs, and any replica of the famous pose.
How do I prompt Pearl Earring for AI image or video?
Single window camera-left, 85mm, then: Pearl-earring portrait of [Subject], Vermeer window, turban implied, a quiet Dutch interior as grade. Forbid extra practicals and replica posing.
